text:
Ana Mendez: APAC inference latency spike — seeing sustained tail latency and 5xxs. Network stats show NIC packet drops on ap-southeast-1 leafs. Suggest we shift traffic off APAC ASAP, gradual if possible. Who can make GSLB weight changes?
Sam Cho: I'm oncall. Confirming packet loss ~35% on a subset of racks, kernel-level drops. Pods still healthy but connections timing out. Agree we should steer. Prefer gradual to avoid cache stampede.
Kai Patel: +1 for gradual. Proposal: decrease ap-southeast-1 weight in 12% steps every 90s to EU and NA pools, monitor 95th latency and 5xxs. If 5xx rate > 1% for 3m, pause and roll back 1 step. Also bump streaming token throttle for that region to reduce long-lived connections.
Rachel Liu: Heads up: eu-central reserved GPU pool is at 83% committed, na-east at 91% (short headroom). Cross-region egress will increase cost and may pressure na-east burst limits. Before shifting more than ~30% check /infra/pools headroom.
Sam Cho: Ok plan:
1) run `gslbctl get-weights ap-southeast-1` to snapshot.
2) do -12% to ap-southeast-1, +6% to eu-central and +6% to na-east.
3) wait 90s, check metrics (latency p95, 5xxs, pool headroom), repeat until ap weight <= 20% or errors improve.
If any step trips our 5xx threshold revert last step. I'll execute and log changes.
Ana Mendez: Add prefixed caching note — enable prefix-KV cache fallback for chat sessions routed to new regions to reduce token regen. Also add a canary flag to keep 5% pinned to APAC for controlled testing.
mike_ops_bot: Deploybot: Sam Cho initiated gslb weight change (delta -12%) at 1900012410. Change id gslb-change-1900012410.
Sam Cho: Ran step 1. Current weights: ap-southeast-1=68%, eu-central=18%, na-east=14%. Executing step -> set ap=56, eu=24, na=20. Command used:
```
# snapshot
gslbctl get-weights ap-southeast-1
# apply
gslbctl set-weights --region ap-southeast-1 --set ap=56,eu-central=24,na-east=20 --change-id gslb-change-1900012410
```
sre-bot: Alert: p95 latency for ap-southeast-1 decreased from 1.9s -> 1.3s after step. 5xxs down from 2.1% -> 1.1%. Monitoring continues.
Kai Patel: Good signal. Check pool headroom: `/infra/pools?region=eu-central` shows 12% free, na-east 6% free. We should avoid pushing na-east above 85% to keep burst cushion. Consider routing next tranche more to eu if available.
Rachel Liu: Cost note: projected egress delta for this shift ~ +$12k/day if we maintain full shift. Recommend we watch for sustained shift >6 hours and open a billing PR if needed.
Ana Mendez: We'll follow the gradual plan and keep 5% pinned. If we hit any cap in na-east, immediate action: stop further steps, change targets to eu-west-2 and na-west-1, and engage infra-allocations for emergency burst.
Sam Cho: Executing second step in 60s. I'll post every step and paste gslb-change IDs. Target owner for rollback: @Kai.
Kai Patel: I'll standby for rollback. Also will pre-warm a couple of instances in eu-west-2 in case we need to shift more there.
Sam Cho: Update: second step applied. weights now ap=44, eu=30, na=26. No spike in 5xxs. Latency improving. Continuing to monitor.
Ana Mendez: Thanks team. After APAC under 30% and stable for 10m we'll create a post-change runbook entry (brief) and a follow-up on capacity/price impact.
Sam Cho: Noted. Change timeline recorded in incident log gslb-change-1900012410. Closing thread once ap-southeast-1 stable or we fully failback.
